value.PublicRemarks: Welcome to 45 Cedar Springs Drive - a beautifully maintained family home in one of Richmond Hill's most sought-after neighbourhoods. Featuring a rare and highly desirable layout with a dedicated main floor office, this bright and spacious residence offers over 4,000 sq ft of total living space designed for modern family living. Situated on a deep lot with an expansive backyard, this home provides exceptional indoor and outdoor space for entertaining and everyday enjoyment. The beautifully finished basement extends the living area with a large recreation room, wet bar, additional fridge, dedicated exercise room, and a classic pool table included - creating the ultimate lower-level retreat. Pride of ownership is evident throughout this meticulously cared-for home, ideally located in a fantastic family-friendly community close to top schools, parks, shopping, and amenities. (id:65552)
